data.rationale: The proposal has the right three-site sequence, parameters and note template, but it drops the "4 or more stars" recipe filter (it says "top recipe") and the "don't click a time slot or Reserve" constraint, and it leaves out the "New note" click and the Allrecipes search-box and Enter details, so an automation would have to guess at those.
